widgets.title: Chat P95 Latency
widgets.query: requests | where name endswith '/api/v1/chat' | summarize p95=percentile(duration, 95)

widgets.title: Recommendation P95 Latency
widgets.query: requests | where name endswith '/api/v1/recommendations/query' | summarize p95=percentile(duration, 95)

widgets.title: Failed Requests
widgets.query: requests | where success == false | summarize failures=count() by name
